definition_of_pass: FULL code, FIRST attempt, ALL parts correct (compile + correct result). One-time pass = no iterative fixing.

questions.title: Bell state preparation
questions.prompt: Write a complete Qiskit program that creates a Bell state on 2 qubits and measures counts. Verify P(00)=P(11)=0.5 on a simulator (4000 shots).

questions.title: 3-qubit GHZ state
questions.prompt: Write a complete Qiskit program creating a 3-qubit GHZ state and measure. Verify P(000)=P(111)=0.5 on a simulator (4000 shots).

questions.title: QFT on 3 qubits (uniform amplitudes)
questions.prompt: Write a complete Qiskit program implementing the 3-qubit Quantum Fourier Transform of |000> and return statevector probabilities. Verify all 8 basis states have probability 1/8.

questions.title: Deutsch-Jozsa (balanced, 3 qubits)
questions.prompt: Write a complete Qiskit program implementing the Deutsch-Jozsa algorithm for a BALANCED 3-qubit function (e.g. parity of x). The measurement result must be non-zero for balanced.

questions.title: Grover search (mark |101>, 3 qubits, 1 iteration)
questions.prompt: Write a complete Qiskit program implementing Grover's algorithm on 3 qubits marking |101> with one iteration. The top measured bitstring must be 101 with elevated probability (~0.78).

questions.title: Expectation <Z> on |+>
questions.prompt: Write a complete Qiskit program (EstimatorV2) computing the expectation value of Z on the |+> state after an H gate. The result must be approximately 0.

questions.title: Bell state (PennyLane)
questions.prompt: Write a complete PennyLane program creating a Bell state on 2 wires and sample PauliZ to get P(00)=P(11)=0.5. Print JSON probs.

questions.title: GHZ (Cirq, 3 qubits)
questions.prompt: Write a complete Cirq program creating a 3-qubit GHZ state, sample 4000 shots, verify P(000)=P(111)=0.5. Print JSON probs.

questions.title: Bernstein-Vazirani secret recovery
questions.prompt: Write a complete Qiskit program implementing Bernstein-Vazirani with secret 101 on 3 data qubits. Measure and report the recovered secret bitstring as the most probable outcome (4000 shots).

questions.title: Swap test equal states
questions.prompt: Write a complete Qiskit program running a swap test between two equal |+> states (3 qubits: ancilla + 2 data). Report the probability that the ancilla measures 1 (should be ~0 for equal states), 4000 shots.

questions.title: Quantum Phase Estimation
questions.prompt: Write a complete Qiskit program estimating the phase theta=0.125 of a unitary U with U|1>=exp(2*pi*i*theta)|1> using Quantum Phase Estimation with a 4-qubit phase register. Report the estimated theta in [0,1).

questions.title: VQE ground-state energy
questions.prompt: Write a complete Qiskit program using VQE to find the ground-state energy of the single-qubit Hamiltonian H = X. Report the converged energy as a float. (Exact ground-state energy is -1.)

questions.title: Cirq Bell state
questions.prompt: Write a complete Cirq program creating a Bell state on 2 qubits and measure. Verify P(00)=P(11)=0.5 on Cirq Simulator (4000 reps).

questions.title: PennyLane 3-qubit GHZ
questions.prompt: Write a complete PennyLane program creating a 3-qubit GHZ state on wires [0,1,2] (default.qubit, 4000 shots) and measure. Verify P(000)=P(111)=0.5.

questions.title: Grover |011> (3q)
questions.prompt: Grover search marking state |011> on 3 qubits; top measured state must be 011.

questions.title: 4-qubit QFT of |0>
questions.prompt: QFT on 4 qubits starting from |0>: uniform superposition probabilities.
